buying_model: Bids on every search for Fernhook, always on in every market. Spend follows how many people search the brand, and Meta, YouTube and CTV ads drive some of those searches.
Always on in every market. Budgets lean into busy seasons and are re-split across markets every quarter.
Always-on prospecting that pushes before and into the spring and fall busy seasons and eases off in slow weeks. Each market's timing differs.
Lead-gen forms, always on. Market budgets are re-split every quarter.
National flights that run several weeks ahead of each busy season, with a low level in between. Each flight targets about three in four markets.
A market test in 8 markets. Each runs its own flight ahead of each busy season and goes dark between flights.
Always-on retargeting of past site visitors. Market budgets are re-split every quarter.
Placement and sponsor fees with local resellers and fleet consultants, set when each market's contracts renew every quarter. Commissions are booked as cost of sale.
Regional live events. Cost lands in the week of each event.
Weekly newsletter and nurture sends, plus blasts for promos. No media cost.
Customer referrals and organic review-site listings.
